definitions.explanation: Government or rule characterized by the use of power to oppress the people. Refers to authoritarian or despotic governance that suppresses the freedom and rights of citizens.

examples.japanese: {圧政|あっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧⟦{民衆|みんしゅう}→民衆：13259_minshuu⟧。
{圧政|あっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{反乱|はんらん}→反乱：11860_hanran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A rebellion against the oppressive rule broke out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{圧政|あっせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{解放|かいほう}→解放：00135_kaihou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The people, freed from years of tyrannical rule, rejoiced at having gained their freedom.

notes:
USAGE:
{圧政|あっせい} is a formal, literary word often found in historical and political writing. It combines {圧|あつ} (pressure, oppression) with {政|せい} (government, rule).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧政|あっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer under tyranny
- {圧政|あっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to stand up against oppression
- {圧政|あっせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{解放|かいほう}される→解放する：22170_kaihousuru⟧: to be freed from tyranny
- {圧政|あっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to impose oppressive rule
